video_title: The 6k Monitor Apple Doesn't Want You To Find
evidence: SponsorRadar records ClickClack sponsoring Better Creating's August 21, 2026 English-language YouTube video. Better Creating has about 264K subscribers and SponsorRadar shows ClickClack has sponsored the channel twice. ClickClack sells tangible workspace hardware including monitors, mechanical keyboards, desk gear and accessories. ClickClack's official Collabs page explicitly invites YouTubers, influencers and streamers for product seeding and affiliate partnerships, and its official contact page publishes partnership@clickclack.io specifically for creator, designer and brand partnerships.
